## Summary

Vexel DB 4.2 is generally available and replaces replication protocol v2 with v3. Because v2 and v3 nodes cannot coexist in a single cluster, and every node must run `vexel migrate-repl` before upgrading, our standard one-node-at-a-time rolling upgrade policy cannot be applied as-is. Version 4.1 receives security fixes until March 2027, which sets the outer deadline for completing the move.
